productionOnlyValidUnits.semanticAudit: The route/page graph is current production source, but digitalReleaseReady is fail-closed because every release has approvedAt: null. Legacy hosted Checkout links are present for a subset of products. Preserve the source as a candidate; do not infer payment success, delivery readiness, customer use, or fulfillment.
dependencies: Stripe payment links or checkout configuration
productionOnlyValidUnits.recoveryInvariantImpact: Must not be confused with R7-C2 paid Chat continuation; no entitlement or fulfillment claim is introduced.
validationNeeded: payment metadata and delivery release audit

productionOnlyValidUnits.name: Privacy / Analytics / Funnel Preservation
productionOnlyValidUnits.whyValid: Current production includes privacy controls and first-party measurement/funnel routes absent from Recovery; their preservation may be required before any RC replaces production.
productionOnlyValidUnits.semanticAudit: The source includes DNT/GPC/local opt-out checks, bounded event schemas, no-IP PostHog initialization, and Redis-backed aggregate/report paths. Missing keys or storage fail closed or degrade without asserting analytics availability, demand, or external provider health.
dependencies: Redis or analytics state where applicable
productionOnlyValidUnits.recoveryInvariantImpact: No external analytics or customer data operation is authorized by this plan.
validationNeeded: provider/env presence audit without reading values
